# HORUS

> A real-time robotics framework for Rust, Python and C++. Nodes exchange typed messages over shared-memory topics with a measured 151 ns one-way cross-process p50, scheduled by a tick loop with per-node rates, execution budgets and deadlines. Apache-2.0.

Writing a HORUS program means implementing the `Node` trait (`tick()` is called on a schedule), publishing and subscribing through `Topic<T>`, and adding the nodes to a `Scheduler`. Rust is the reference binding; Python and C++ share the same message types and shared-memory transport.

Two pages are worth reading before writing any code: **Quick Start** for the shape of a program, and **Common Mistakes** for the nine things that most often go wrong. `llms-full.txt` beside this file carries every page in full.

## Start here

- [Installation](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/getting-started/installation): Install HORUS on Linux, macOS, or Windows
- [Quick Start](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/getting-started/quick-start): Build your first HORUS application in 10 minutes
- [Choosing a Language](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/getting-started/choosing-language): Should you use Rust, Python, or C++ with HORUS?
- [Common Mistakes](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/getting-started/common-mistakes): Avoid these common beginner pitfalls when using HORUS
- [Building Your Second Application](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/getting-started/second-application): Build a 3-node sensor pipeline with filtering and display

## Core concepts

- [What is HORUS?](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/what-is-horus): A high-performance framework for building distributed systems with sub-microsecond IPC
- [Core Concepts - Nodes](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/core-concepts-nodes): Understanding HORUS nodes and their lifecycle
- [Core Concepts - Topic](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/core-concepts-topic): Understanding HORUS pub/sub communication system
- [Core Concepts - Scheduler](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/core-concepts-scheduler): Understanding HORUS priority-based scheduler and execution orchestration
- [Execution Classes](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/execution-classes): The timing policy you can ignore until you need it — tick rate, order, rate, and what happens when a node overruns
- [Message Types](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/message-types): Standard HORUS message types for robotics applications
- [node! Macro Guide](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/node-macro): Write less code with the node! macro
- [Actions](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/actions): Long-running tasks with feedback, cancellation, and preemption
- [Services](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/services): Synchronous request/response RPC between nodes
- [Multi-Language Support](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/multi-language): Use HORUS with Python, Rust, and C++
- [Communication Patterns Overview](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/communication-overview): Understanding HORUS communication primitives — Topics, Actions, Services, and Network
- [Architecture Overview](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/architecture): Understanding HORUS - the node model, communication patterns, scheduling, and memory system
- [Core Concepts - POD Types](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/core-concepts-podtopic): How HORUS auto-detects POD types for zero-serialization, ultra-fast communication
- [HFrame (moved to Transform Frame)](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/hframe): Redirect stub — the transform frame documentation now lives at /concepts/transform-frame
- [Transform Frame System](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/transform-frame): High-performance coordinate frame management for real-time robotics
- [Goals & Vision](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/goals): What HORUS is trying to achieve and the problems it solves
- [Core Concepts](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts): Fundamental HORUS concepts and architecture
- [Real-Time Nodes](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/concepts/realtime-nodes): Build time-critical robotics applications with per-node timing constraints and deadline monitoring

## Rust API reference

- [horus_core](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/core): Core runtime API - nodes, communication, and scheduling
- [Standard Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/messages): Standard message types for robotics communication
- [Advanced Examples](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/examples/advanced-examples): Complex patterns, multi-process systems, and Python integration
- [horus_macros](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/macros): Procedural macros for reducing boilerplate
- [Tensor Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/tensor-messages): Zero-copy tensor types for ML workloads
- [Basic Examples](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/examples/basic-examples): Simple HORUS patterns for beginners
- [TensorPool API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/tensor-pool): Zero-copy tensor memory management for high-performance robotics and AI/ML
- [API Reference](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api): Complete API reference for the HORUS robotics framework
- [Geometry Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/geometry-messages): 3D and 2D spatial primitives for position, orientation, and motion
- [Perception Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/perception-messages): 3D perception, point cloud, depth, landmark, tracking, and segmentation message types
- [Force & Tactile Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/force-messages): Force sensing, tactile arrays, impedance control, and haptic feedback
- [Control Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/control-messages): Motor control, servo, PID, trajectory, and joint command messages
- [Sensor Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/sensor-messages): Lidar, IMU, odometry, GPS, range sensors, and battery state
- [Machine Learning Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/ml-messages): Segmentation mask messages and tensor I/O for ML inference nodes
- [Navigation Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/navigation-messages): Path planning, goals, waypoints, occupancy grids, and cost maps
- [Diagnostics Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/diagnostics-messages): System monitoring, health checks, heartbeats, and error reporting
- [Vision Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/vision-messages): Camera, image, calibration, and visual detection messages
- [Clock & Time API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/api/clock-api): Unified time system for wall clock, deterministic simulation, and replay modes
- [Rust Documentation](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust): HORUS Rust API, library, and examples
- [Rust Examples](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/rust/examples): Working examples demonstrating HORUS patterns in Rust

## C++ API reference

- [C++ Real-Time Guide](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/realtime): Budget, deadline, miss policies, SCHED_FIFO, CPU pinning, and watchdog configuration
- [C++ Performance Guide](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/performance): Zero-copy patterns, loan API, pool sizing, and FFI overhead
- [C++ Testing Guide](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/testing): Unit testing, sanitizers, stress testing, and cross-process verification
- [C++ Error Handling](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/error-handling): Exception safety, null checks, RAII, and panic-safe FFI
- [C++ Hardware Integration](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/hardware): Connect real sensors and actuators using horus::Node
- [C++ API Reference](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api): Complete API reference for the HORUS C++ bindings — scheduling, nodes, topics, services, and actions
- [Scheduler API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/scheduler): Complete API reference for the HORUS C++ Scheduler — builder pattern, node registration, real-time execution, and runtime queries
- [Node API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/node): Complete API reference for the HORUS C++ Node class — struct-based nodes, LambdaNode, lifecycle, pub/sub, and introspection
- [Publisher & Subscriber API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/topic): Complete API reference for HORUS C++ zero-copy IPC — Publisher, Subscriber, LoanedSample, BorrowedSample, and all 61 message types
- [Services & Actions API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/services): Complete API reference for HORUS C++ services (request/response RPC) and actions (long-running tasks with progress and cancellation)
- [TensorPool, Image & PointCloud API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/pool): Zero-copy SHM-backed memory pools for camera images, lidar point clouds, and neural network tensors
- [Runtime Parameters API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/params): Dynamic configuration for C++ nodes -- set, get, and live-tune parameters at runtime
- [TransformFrame API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/transform): Coordinate frame tree for tracking spatial relationships between robot links, sensors, and world frames
- [Logging & BlackBox API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/logging): Structured logging visible in the CLI and blackbox-tagged incident entries in the HORUS log buffer
- [Duration & Frequency API](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/duration): User-defined literals for durations and frequencies, plus the Miss policy enum for deadline handling
- [Sensor Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/sensor-messages): LaserScan, Imu, Odometry, JointState, RangeSensor, BatteryState, NavSatFix, and more
- [Control Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/control-messages): CmdVel, MotorCommand, ServoCommand, JointCommand, PidConfig, and more
- [Geometry Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/geometry-messages): Twist, Pose2D, Pose3D, Point3, Vector3, Quaternion, TransformStamped, and covariance types
- [Navigation Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/navigation-messages): NavGoal, GoalResult, Waypoint, PathPlan, VelocityObstacle
- [Detection & Vision Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/detection-messages): BoundingBox2D/3D, Detection, Detection3D, TrackedObject, Landmark, SegmentationMask
- [Diagnostics Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/diagnostics-messages): Heartbeat, EmergencyStop, DiagnosticStatus, ResourceUsage, SafetyStatus, NodeHeartbeat
- [Force & Tactile Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/force-messages): WrenchStamped, ForceCommand, ContactInfo, HapticFeedback, ImpedanceParameters
- [Tracking & Perception Messages](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/api/tracking-messages): TrackedObject, TrackingHeader, Landmark, LandmarkArray, SegmentationMask, Clock, input messages
- [Basic Examples](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/examples/basic): Complete working C++ projects — from hello world to multi-node pub/sub
- [Advanced Examples](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp/examples/advanced): Multi-process pipelines, cross-language systems, RT control, and production patterns
- [C++ Documentation](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/cpp): HORUS C++ API, guides, and examples

- [Depending on HORUS](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/development/depending-on-horus): Using HORUS from a hand-written Cargo.toml — the path dependency, the two patch tables it needs, and what breaks when the tree moves
- [Environment Variables](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/development/environment-variables): Every HORUS_* variable shipped code reads, every one HORUS sets for a process it starts, and the class deliberately left out
- [AI Integration](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/development/ai-integration): Integrate AI and ML models into HORUS robotics applications
- [Error Handling](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/development/error-handling): Unified error types, result handling, and best practices for HORUS applications

## Advanced runtime

- [Real-Time Configuration (RtConfig)](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/advanced/rt-config): Configure system-level real-time settings for deterministic execution on top of HORUS shared-memory IPC

- [Record & Replay](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/advanced/record-replay): Recording and tick-perfect replay for debugging, testing, and analysis
- [Circuit Breaker](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/advanced/circuit-breaker): Fault tolerance pattern for preventing cascading failures in node execution
- [Scheduling Intelligence](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/advanced/scheduling-intelligence): Execution class annotations for optimized scheduling
- [Network Backends](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/advanced/network-backends): Communication backends in HORUS — automatic shared-memory IPC with opt-in LAN replication
- [Scheduler Configuration](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/advanced/scheduler-configuration): Configuring the HORUS scheduler with the fluent node builder API, execution classes, and per-node settings
- [Execution Modes](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/advanced/execution-modes): Understanding HORUS scheduler execution modes: Sequential and Parallel
- [Deterministic Execution](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/advanced/deterministic-execution): Achieving reproducible execution in HORUS for testing, debugging, and replay
- [Safety Monitor](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/advanced/safety-monitor): Real-time safety monitoring with watchdogs, WCET enforcement, and emergency stop
- [Production Deployment](https://docs.horusrobotics.dev/advanced/deployment): Deploying HORUS applications to production robots with real-time features, safety monitoring, and performance tuning
